name: Paginated Sync (Example)
description: Template for syncing items from one API (Source) to another (Destination). Demonstrates cursor persistence in D1, the 50-subrequest budget, and dry_run for safety. Edit this script to fit your real APIs — it will not run as-is until you fill in real endpoints.

params_schema.label: Dry run
params_schema.description: If true, fetch and inspect data but don't write to the destination.

params_schema.label: Reset cursor
params_schema.description: Discard the saved cursor and start over from the beginning.

params_schema.label: Items per run
params_schema.description: How many items to process this invocation. Capped at 40 to stay under the Workers 50-subrequest-per-invocation limit (1 fetch list + 40 detail fetches + 1 batch write = 42).
